globalNotes: Dark theme throughout (near-black background ~#0E1418 to #161C20, cards slightly lighter ~#1A2228). Sticky top nav bar (STRESS MONITOR + back chevron + gear) persists across all three scroll positions. Single continuous vertical scroll screen. Scroll order: IMG_3895 (top: nav, day-selector, gauge, intraday chart, descriptive text, top of TOTAL DAY card) -> IMG_3896 (middle: tail of chart, descriptive text, full TOTAL DAY card, top of NON ACTIVITY card) -> IMG_3897 (bottom: full NON ACTIVITY card, full SLEEP card, start of SESSIONS row). A circular floating WHOOP logo button ('/\/' glyph in a blue-rimmed dark circle) sits bottom-right, overlapping content, on all scroll positions (likely the WHOOP Coach launcher -> EXCLUDED). Status bar shows 09:35, silent/notifications-off bell icon, cellular, wifi, battery 39%. All section headers are uppercase, white, bold, with a small line-icon to the left. 'VS. TYPICAL TUESDAY' is grey. Trend % pills are small rounded grey chips with a triangle arrow.
excluded: Floating circular WHOOP Coach / AI button (blue-rimmed dark circle with '/\/' WHOOP logo glyph) anchored bottom-right, overlapping content on every scroll position

layout.name: Top nav bar
layout.description: Sticky header. Left: white back chevron '<'. Center: title 'STRESS MONITOR' in bold white uppercase, letter-spaced, ~17-18px. Right: white gear/settings outline icon. Sits below the iOS status bar (09:35, bell-with-slash mute icon, cellular bars, wifi, battery '39' at ~39%). Background matches page dark.
layout.interaction: Back chevron pops to previous screen (Home). Gear opens Stress Monitor settings.

layout.name: Day selector
layout.description: Centered horizontal date stepper below nav. Left chevron '<' (white/active), center label 'TODAY' bold white uppercase letter-spaced, right chevron '>' (dimmed grey, indicating no future day).
layout.interaction: Left chevron navigates to previous day; right chevron forward (disabled on today).

layout.name: Stress gauge (semicircular speedometer)
layout.description: Large 180-degree arc gauge, opening downward. Arc sweeps left-to-right through a color gradient: blue (#3E8BD6) at far left -> teal/green (#3FE0A0) at top -> yellow/amber (#E0A23C) at far right. A white needle/tick points from center to the lower-left (~low region). Center big value '0.4' in very large bold white (~64px). Below value: 'LOW' in blue (#4A9FE0) bold uppercase. Below that: timestamp '09:35' in grey. Arc endpoints labeled: '0.0' under left end, '3.0' under right end (grey). A circled 'i' info icon (grey outline) floats to the upper-right of the gauge.
layout.interaction: Info 'i' icon opens an explainer about the stress score scale.

layout.name: Intraday stress line chart
layout.description: Full-width line chart of stress over the day. Y-axis (left) labeled 0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 (grey, gridlines faint). X-axis labeled '09:35', '18:00', '02:00', '09:35' (grey) spanning ~24h from this morning to now. Line series is color-coded by stress level: green (#5FE0A0) during higher daytime stress (left ~half, oscillating ~1.0-2.0 with spikes), transitioning to blue (#5AC8E8) for the low overnight/calm portion (right ~half, flat ~0.3-0.5). A shaded sleep region (semi-transparent lighter rectangle) covers the overnight span on the right, capped by a horizontal blue line at the top (~3.0 level) and a crescent-moon icon above it marking the sleep window. A dashed vertical white line at the far right marks 'now' (09:35) ending in a small white dot on the x-axis. A magnifier/zoom button (circle with '+' in a rounded dark square) floats over the right side of the chart for zoom.
layout.interaction: Magnifier button zooms/expands the chart; chart likely scrubable to inspect points.

layout.name: Descriptive summary text
layout.description: Multi-line white sentence below the chart, ~22px regular weight, left-aligned: 'Your body is signaling low stress. This indicates your cardiovascular system is stable, calm, and near its resting state.'
literals: Your body is signaling low stress. This indicates your cardiovascular system is stable, calm, and near its resting state.

layout.name: TOTAL DAY card header
layout.description: Card (rounded, slightly lighter dark panel). Header row: a small gauge/speedometer line-icon then 'TOTAL DAY' bold white uppercase. Below it subtitle: 'TUE, JUN 30 STRESS' in white bold + 'VS. TYPICAL TUESDAY' in grey, same line.

layout.name: TOTAL DAY comparison bars (dual stacked bars)
layout.description: Two horizontal stacked bars stacked vertically. TOP bar = today's distribution: a long light-blue (#6FAEE6) segment (LOW) filling ~95%, then a short bright-green (#3FE0A0) segment (MEDIUM) at the right end; no amber visible (HIGH=0). BOTTOM bar = typical/baseline distribution: a muted blue-grey (#5A7A95) LOW segment (~45%), a green (#3FA070) MEDIUM segment (~45%), and an amber/brown (#9A7A2E) HIGH segment (~10%) at the right. The two bars visually compare today vs typical proportions.

layout.name: TOTAL DAY metric trio (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH)
layout.description: Three columns of duration + trend + label. Col1: big value '10:19' (white bold ~28px), grey chip with up-triangle '131%', label 'LOW' with small blue (#5AA0E0) square swatch. Col2: '0:38', grey chip with down-triangle '87%', 'MEDIUM' with green (#3FE0A0) swatch. Col3: '0:00', grey chip with down-triangle '100%', 'HIGH' with amber (#E0A23C) swatch. Up-triangle = higher than typical, down-triangle = lower than typical (both shown in white inside grey chips, not colored red/green).

layout.name: TOTAL DAY description
layout.description: Grey regular text: 'Stress experienced throughout the day including sleep and activities.'
literals: Stress experienced throughout the day including sleep and activities.

layout.name: TOTAL DAY 'SEE TRENDS' link
layout.description: Bottom-left of card: 'SEE TRENDS' white bold uppercase letter-spaced, followed by a white right-arrow '->'.
layout.interaction: Navigates to the Stress trends view for Total Day.

layout.name: NON ACTIVITY card header
layout.description: Second card. Header: a small person/standing-figure line-icon then 'NON ACTIVITY' bold white uppercase. Subtitle 'TUE, JUN 30 STRESS' white bold + 'VS. TYPICAL TUESDAY' grey.

layout.name: NON ACTIVITY metric trio
layout.description: Col1: '0:29', grey chip up-triangle '172%' (note: IMG_3896 reads 172%; IMG_3897 of same card reads 171% — value ~171-172%), label 'LOW' blue swatch. Col2: '0:18' (IMG_3896) / '0:19' (IMG_3897) — value updated between captures ~0:18-0:19, grey chip down-triangle '35%', 'MEDIUM' green swatch. Col3: '0:00', grey chip down-triangle '100%', 'HIGH' amber swatch.

layout.name: NON ACTIVITY 'SEE TRENDS' link

layout.name: SLEEP card header

layout.name: SLEEP comparison bars (dual stacked)
layout.description: TOP bar (today): light-blue (#6FAEE6) LOW segment filling ~95%, tiny bright-green (#3FE0A0) MEDIUM segment at the very right; no amber. BOTTOM bar (typical): muted blue-grey LOW ~70%, green MEDIUM ~22%, amber/brown HIGH ~8% at right.

layout.name: SLEEP metric trio
layout.description: Col1: '9:49', grey chip up-triangle '34%', 'LOW' blue swatch. Col2: '0:20', grey chip down-triangle '86%', 'MEDIUM' green swatch. Col3: '0:00', grey chip down-triangle '100%', 'HIGH' amber swatch.

layout.name: SLEEP 'SEE TRENDS' link

layout.name: SESSIONS section header
layout.description: Grey uppercase label 'SESSIONS' above a horizontal row of tiles.

layout.name: SESSIONS tiles (horizontal cards)
layout.description: Horizontally-scrolling row of rounded image tiles (guided breathing/relaxation or activation sessions). Tile 1: photo of a calm lake/mountains at dusk (blue tones), a small circular icon (curved-arrow / relax glyph) bottom-left and a partially-visible white bold label 'INCREASE' at bottom. Tile 2: red/pink marble-swirl image, small circular gauge icon bottom-left and 'INCREASE' label at bottom (label cut off by screen bottom). Tiles appear to be 'Increase'/'Decrease' stress sessions. Only the top portion of these tiles is visible at this scroll position.
layout.interaction: Tapping a tile opens that guided stress session (e.g. increase/decrease stress / breathing).
